positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on REST API using .NET framework, to be used by new mobile app for iOS.

Worked on flagship product to enhance current implementation as well as create new features, using Java J2EE and PostgreSQL/Oracle, to web services, database, REST API and other technologies.

positions.title: Contract Programmer
positions.description: Implemented and maintained code for in app purchasing for iTunes and Google Play, as well as cleaning and refactoring code between existing JavaScript code and newer C# code for Unity3D.

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description: In charge of automatic ticketing system for reporting bad client statuses as well as working close with quality assurance to keep web site and database up-to-date. Implemented missing features and stored procedures to MS SQL database for expansion of utility for back office.

positions.title: Jr. Programmer
positions.description: Programmer in charge of mobile UI, in app purchasing for iOS and Android, mobile-specific actions, single player structure and client-server communication for saving progress for single player. Other duties included implementing a logging system, optimizing texture packing, maintaining administrative executables, and quality assurance.
